name: tired-gen-z-boy-mall-escalator
image_purpose: Create an unstaged everyday social-lifestyle scene in a shopping mall.

prompt.main_subject: An original adult man with medium-length messy black hair, natural skin texture, and a calm unreadable expression. No real-person likeness or identity lock.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body eye-level smartphone framing. He stands at the top landing of an indoor escalator, leaning against a glass railing with a wooden hand rest; right elbow on the railing, right hand near the back of the neck, head tilted down, shoulders slightly slouched, legs lightly crossed. Oversized cream T-shirt, light-wash baggy jeans, black-and-white low-top sneakers, and a black one-shoulder backpack.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor mall lighting, neutral white balance, natural reflections on glass and metal, quiet spacious atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Handheld smartphone photograph, full-body eye-level composition, natural sharpness with mild softness, no portrait mode, no background blur, realistic everyday imperfections.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic candid indoor daytime smartphone photograph of an original adult man with medium-length messy black hair standing at the top landing of an indoor escalator in a modern shopping mall. He leans against a glass railing with a wooden hand rest, head tilted downward and shoulders slightly slouched in a quiet introspective pose. He wears an oversized cream T-shirt, light-wash baggy jeans, black-and-white low-top sneakers, and a black backpack on one shoulder. Glass railing, vertical metal supports, escalator belt, clean white walls, neutral tiled floor, and open mall space form the background. Soft even mall lighting, neutral white balance, natural reflections, full-body eye-level framing, believable unstaged smartphone realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, real-person likeness, identity lock, studio lighting, cinematic grading, fashion posing, beauty filter, smooth skin, CGI, portrait blur, dramatic lighting, exaggerated expressions, oversharpening, watermark, text, logo

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Adapt from the existing text prompt and folder/file naming only. Preserve the candid mall-escalator concept with an original adult subject.

changes: Removed reference-image identity-lock language while preserving the candid scene and styling intent.
